purpose: Exclude even the smallest amount from permission or neglect.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Minimal quantity + たりとも + negative
We cannot waste even a second.
We will not leave even one person behind.
I do not want to pay even one yen extra.
formation: Minimal quantity + たりとも + negative
restrictions: Often with 一人, 一秒, or 一円.
mistake: A negative or prohibitive conclusion normally follows.
